subject: POC Preflight: MAP sprint, org onboarding & network handoff
messages:
From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
To: Claire Zhang <c.zhang@curelink.io>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 26 Sep 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: POC Preflight: MAP sprint, org onboarding & network handoff

Hi Claire —

Thanks again for the time yesterday. As discussed I put together a short preflight checklist for the POC MAP so we can lock the environment and the close timeline. Can you confirm the items below and share any missing contacts/deadlines on your side? I put suggested target dates in parentheses.

1) Org & access
   - Confirm org admin who will receive the initial Redwood organization invite (DevOps lead) (Due: Tue 2026-09-28)
   - Confirm required role mapping (Admin / Engineer / Viewer) for two pilot users (Due: Tue 2026-09-28)

2) API keys & sandbox tokens
   - We will provision short-lived API keys for the evaluation tenant. Requesting list of recipient emails for key distribution (Due: Wed 2026-09-29)

3) Network (IP allowlist & peering) — critical for Dedicated test mode
   - Please confirm your egress IP ranges for allowlist (we need CIDR blocks) (Due: Mon 2026-09-28)
   - VPC peering: provide VPC ID, preferred peering window (we can accommodate maintenance windows 10pm–2am PT) (Due: Mon 2026-10-04)

4) Security/compliance artifacts (high level)
   - Quick SOC 2 snapshot & data handling note — we can provide standard FAQ and SOC pointer doc (Due: Wed 2026-09-30)

5) Close timeline suggestion
   - Target POC start: 2026-10-06
   - End of evaluation / decision: 2026-11-03

Attachments: MAP-draft-CureLink-20260926.pdf (high level workback), vpc-peering-config-template.yaml (sample)

If you can reply with the IP ranges and the two contacts for org invite, I will get the invite and the keys issued and schedule a short runbook review with your DevOps.

Thanks —
Jonas Weber
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
jonas_weber@redwood.com
https://www.redwood.inference/

From: Claire Zhang <c.zhang@curelink.io>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
Cc: DevOps Team <devops@curelink.io>, Tony Morales <tony@curelink.io>
Date: Sat, 26 Sep 2026 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: POC Preflight: MAP sprint, org onboarding & network handoff

Jonas —

Appreciate the clear checklist. Quick responses inline below:  

> 1) Org & access
Our DevOps lead is Claire Zhang (me) and the two pilot users are: lina.wang@curelink.io (platform engineer) and ajay.patel@curelink.io (data scientist). Role mapping: both should be Engineered-level (can we call that "Engineer" role).

> 2) API keys & sandbox tokens
Please issue keys to the two pilot users above. We prefer keys to be manually delivered through the invite flow rather than email.

> 3) Network (IP allowlist & peering)
Our egress CIDR blocks (public-facing) are: 34.82.16.0/22, 35.196.0.0/16. For the VPC peering: VPC-ID: vpc-0a1b2c3d (us-west-2). Preferred peering window: 2026-10-02 22:00–02:00 PT. We also have a maintenance blackout on 2026-10-04, so avoid that date.

I attached the CSV with our IP list (curelink-ip-allowlist.csv) and the peering contact is tony@curelink.io who is copied.

> 4) Security/compliance artifacts
Please send the SOC pointer doc and the short FAQ. We'll have security triage on 2026-09-30.

Agree with the proposed timelines — good to go on our side pending your invite and the runbook review.

Thanks,
Claire Zhang
Head of DevOps, CureLink Health
c.zhang@curelink.io

Attachments: curelink-ip-allowlist.csv

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Claire Zhang <c.zhang@curelink.io>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 26 Sep 2026 14:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: POC Preflight: MAP sprint, org onboarding & network handoff

Thanks Claire — this is great and the CIDRs look good. Two quick operational notes to keep the MAP tight:  

- I'll create a short runbook (30m) for the peering cutover that covers the two-step validation: (1) ping & route validation, (2) sample inference call over peered path. Can you confirm whether you want the sample inference using your test dataset or our canonical sample prompt? (Suggest your test dataset to surface any mapping issues.)

- For API key delivery: Jonas, please set keys to expire after 14 days for the pilot, and include token rotation instructions in the invite email.

Action items & owner summary (due dates):
- Redwood: send org invite + keys to Lina & Ajay (Jonas) — due 2026-09-29
- CureLink: confirm peering acceptance and maintenance window (Claire/Tony) — due 2026-09-28
- Redwood: share SOC snapshot + FAQ (Marissa) — due 2026-09-30

I'll open a short calendar block for the runbook on 2026-10-01 09:00 PT — holding for your confirmation.

Marissa Cole
Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Claire Zhang <c.zhang@curelink.io>, Tony Morales <tony@curelink.io>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 27 Sep 2026 08:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: POC Preflight: MAP sprint, org onboarding & network handoff

Claire / Tony —

Quick commercial note so procurement has visibility: per our standard MAP offer I'm adding a one-month evaluation credit on Dedicated so CureLink can run up to 250k tokens during the pilot. If you need a formal PO or a shortened SOW addendum for the trial terms, let me know and I can loop Legal / Procurement.

Also confirming our standard procurement path:
- PO accepted via DocuSign link (I can send)
- Billing contact: finance@curelink.io (please confirm)

If that all looks correct we'll keep the peering window and dates as-is and proceed with the invites.

Best,
Ben Carter
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.com

From: Claire Zhang <c.zhang@curelink.io>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: DevOps Team <devops@curelink.io>, Tony Morales <tony@curelink.io>
Date: Mon, 28 Sep 2026 09:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: POC Preflight: MAP sprint, org onboarding & network handoff

Ben / team —

Thanks — confirm billing contact is finance@curelink.io and we will accept the one-month evaluation credit. Tony will coordinate the peering acceptance during the 2026-10-02 window.

Jonas — please send the org invite to lina.wang@curelink.io and ajay.patel@curelink.io and put the keys behind invite delivery as requested. Marissa — calendar invite for 2026-10-01 09:00 PT is good for the runbook; Tony will attend.

I'll mark the MAP-draft as accepted for the preflight. Looking forward to the kickoff.

Claire Zhang
Head of DevOps, CureLink Health
c.zhang@curelink.io
